verdict.rationale: Make documents scheduling scenarios directly: there is a 'schedule a scenario' help page, and webhook-triggered scenarios can be set to process queued requests periodically, running whenever the schedule criteria are met. For the AI-native angle, the MCP server lets AI clients view and modify scenarios, which implies but does not explicitly show schedule management. Missing for 10: detailed schedule options (intervals, cron-style or calendar rules), explicit API/MCP support for setting schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
